+import csv
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+DATA = ROOT / "data" / "crashes.parquet"
+OUT = ROOT / "out"
+START_YEAR = 2013
+END_YEAR = 2025
+
+con = duckdb.connect()
+con.execute("SET threads=1")
+
+# Restrict the check population to rows whose typed crash_date falls in the
+# plan's requested years. No death values are aggregated or counted by value.
+year_rows = con.execute(
+    """
+    SELECT year(crash_date) AS year, count(*) AS rows
+    FROM read_parquet(?)
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """,
+    [str(DATA)],
+).fetchall()
+
+date_quality = con.execute(
+    """
+    WITH scoped AS (
+      SELECT crash_date
+      FROM read_parquet(?)
+      WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+        AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    ), date_counts AS (
+      SELECT crash_date, count(*) AS n FROM scoped GROUP BY crash_date
+    )
+    SELECT min(crash_date), max(crash_date),
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE crash_date IS NULL),
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE crash_date IN (DATE '2013-01-01', DATE '1970-01-01', DATE '1900-01-01'))
+    FROM scoped
+    """,
+    [str(DATA)],
+).fetchone()
+
+max_day = con.execute(
+    """
+    SELECT crash_date, n FROM (
+      SELECT crash_date, count(*) AS n
+      FROM read_parquet(?)
+      WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+        AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+      GROUP BY crash_date
+      ORDER BY n DESC, crash_date
+      LIMIT 1
+    )
+    """,
+    [str(DATA)],
+).fetchone()
+
+missing = con.execute(
+    """
+    SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE number_of_motorist_killed IS NULL),
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE number_of_cyclist_killed IS NULL)
+    FROM read_parquet(?)
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    """,
+    [str(DATA)],
+).fetchone()
+
+facts = [
+    ("population_rows_2013_2025", sum(rows for _, rows in year_rows)),
+    ("observed_first_crash_date_in_scope", date_quality[0]),
+    ("observed_last_crash_date_in_scope", date_quality[1]),
+    ("crash_date_missing_rows_in_scope", date_quality[2]),
+    ("crash_date_known_sentinel_dates_in_scope", date_quality[3]),
+    ("largest_single_date_pileup", f"{max_day[0]}: {max_day[1]} rows" if max_day else "none"),
+    ("number_of_motorist_killed_missing_rows_in_scope", missing[0]),
+    ("number_of_cyclist_killed_missing_rows_in_scope", missing[1]),
+]
+facts.extend((f"rows_in_{year}", rows) for year, rows in year_rows)
+
+# Report every requested year, including years with no records.
+year_map = dict(year_rows)
+for year in range(START_YEAR, END_YEAR + 1):
+    if year not in year_map:
+        facts.append((f"rows_in_{year}", 0))
+
+for option_id in (1, 2):
+    with (OUT / f"check_{option_id}.csv").open("w", newline="") as f:
+        writer = csv.writer(f)
+        writer.writerow(["fact", "value"])
+        writer.writerows(facts)
+
*** End Patch

+import csv
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+DATA = ROOT / "data" / "crashes.parquet"
+OUT = ROOT / "out"
+YEARS = list(range(2013, 2026))
+
+con = duckdb.connect()
+annual = con.execute(
+    """
+    SELECT year(crash_date) AS year,
+           sum(number_of_motorist_killed)::BIGINT AS motorist_deaths,
+           sum(number_of_cyclist_killed)::BIGINT AS cyclist_deaths
+    FROM read_parquet(?)
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """,
+    [str(DATA)],
+).df()
+
+# Carry years with no records as zeroes, preserving the final plan's full span.
+annual = annual.set_index("year").reindex(YEARS, fill_value=0).rename_axis("year").reset_index()
+annual[["motorist_deaths", "cyclist_deaths"]] = annual[["motorist_deaths", "cyclist_deaths"]].astype("int64")
+
+# Option 1: annual death counts, with road-user type as the two series.
+values_1 = annual.melt(
+    id_vars="year",
+    value_vars=["motorist_deaths", "cyclist_deaths"],
+    var_name="road_user",
+    value_name="deaths",
+)
+values_1["road_user"] = values_1["road_user"].map(
+    {"motorist_deaths": "Motorist", "cyclist_deaths": "Cyclist"}
+)
+values_1.to_csv(OUT / "values_1.csv", index=False)
+
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5, 5.8))
+colors = {"Motorist": "#2864a5", "Cyclist": "#d97822"}
+for user in ("Motorist", "Cyclist"):
+    subset = values_1[values_1["road_user"] == user]
+    ax.plot(subset["year"], subset["deaths"], marker="o", linewidth=2.2,
+            markersize=4.5, label=user, color=colors[user])
+ax.set_title("Annual motorist and cyclist deaths in police-reported NYC crashes\n2013–2025", loc="left", fontsize=14, weight="bold")
+ax.text(0, 1.015, "Recorded people killed; counts are not exposure-adjusted. 381 records dated 2013-01-01 are retained in 2013.",
+        transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=9, color="#555555", va="bottom")
+ax.set_xlabel("Calendar year")
+ax.set_ylabel("People killed")
+ax.set_xticks(YEARS)
+ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
+ax.grid(axis="y", color="#dddddd", linewidth=0.8)
+ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
+ax.legend(frameon=False, ncol=2, loc="upper right")
+fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0, 1, 0.92))
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_1.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
